why: B reads the remark literally: a functor (f₀, f₁) between ep-groupoids with f₀ sc-smooth has f₁ sc-smooth, plus the local neighbourhoods and the formula. As its author predicted, B does not hold as we read it. not_B applies B to the project's remarkFunctor on ℤ/3 × ℝ ⇉ ℝ (trivial action): the identity on objects, (g, y) ↦ (g², y) for y > 0 and (g, y) for y ≤ 0. Its object map is sc-smooth (isScSmoothMap_remarkFunctor_obj) but its morphism map is not (not_isScSmoothMap_remarkFunctor_mor). A contains this counterexample (remark_definition_7_7_counterexample) and the corrected remark: isScSmoothMap_mor_of_continuous, the iff with continuity, the formula mor_eq_srcInv_obj_src, and EpFunctor.continuous_mor. So A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. The exact difference is the hypothesis 'f₁ continuous'. BRepaired is B with Continuous f₁ added, and A ⇔ BRepaired is proved both ways. A_to_BRepaired builds the text's neighbourhoods: U(φ) = (a sheet of s at φ) ∩ f₁⁻¹(sheet of s at f₁ φ), restricted with IsScDiffeoOn.restrict. BRepaired_to_A takes the main theorem and the backward half of the iff from BRepaired. It re-proves the formula, continuous_mor, the forward half of the iff and the counterexample outright from non-item project lemmas. Universes: 0 (the counterexample has none).
B_issue: B is formalized literally, without continuity of f₁, which the text's choice f(U(φ)) ⊂ U(ψ) needs. The author flags this in the docstring and sketches the ℤ/2 analogue of the project's counterexample. That makes B false (not_B), which matches the project's reading. The corrected version, BRepaired in the Items file, is equivalent to A.
intended: BRepaired (B plus Continuous f₁): A_to_BRepaired and BRepaired_to_A both proved and #rt_check OK, both using their hypothesis.
overlap: B_to_A (ex falso via not_B): 449 shared project theorems. These are the construction of trivialZ3EpGroupoid (actionEpGroupoid and its proof fields, rnPolyfold / rnChart, the fibred-product and sub-M-polyfold glue), remarkFunctor and its proof fields, isScSmoothMap_remarkFunctor_obj, not_continuous_remarkFunctor_mor and not_isScSmoothMap_remarkFunctor_mor: the project's counterexample minus its final packaging. BRepaired_to_A: 450, the same set, plus EpFunctor.isScSmoothMap_mor.
